wargear.name: Death-mask
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A gilded helm cast in the austere, grieving face of the Primarch. The model gains Fear (1) and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Grail of the Red Tide
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A chalice of sanctified blood carried with the unit and shared before the charge. Every model in the unit gains Feel No Pain (6+).

option.text: The Sergeant may take a weapon of the Host
Up to three models may take a Wing-spar glaive
Up to three Ofanim may take an Encarmine sabre
Up to four Erelim may take an Angelus bolter
The Sergeant may wear a Death-mask
The unit may carry a Grail of the Red Tide

modifiers.text: The Golden Host fights as a dance, and is as fragile: +1 I, -1 T.
Crimson Paladins hit like falling bastions: +1 S, -1 I.
Ofanim, shielded by the Primarch's grace: 5+ Invulnerable Save, -1 M.
Blood Angels would sooner be at the blade: +1 WS, -1 BS.
The Red Thirst in the captains: +1 A, -1 CL.
A furnace of old rage: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Grail of the Red Tide: Feel No Pain (6+).

rules.name: Sun Behind Them
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Descent of the Host). A unit with this rule gains Deep Strike. On the turn it arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike it may still declare a Charge.

rules.name: The Red Thirst
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Thirst of the Red Wings). A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Charge roll. If it destroys an enemy unit in combat, it may immediately make a free move of up to 3" toward the nearest enemy unit. At the start of its Assault phase, if an enemy unit is within 12", it must declare a Charge against one if able.

rules.name: Unbroken Court
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Celestial Court). A unit with this rule may re-roll failed Morale Checks. While it is within 6" of a friendly Warlord or High Command model it passes them automatically.

rules.name: Entombed Rage
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Pyre-Brothers of Baal). If a unit with this rule is charged, it fights at its normal Initiative in that combat and adds +1 to its Attacks. It also gains Fear (1).

rites.name: The Descent of the Host
rites.flavor: They fall in a spray of gold, and the sun is behind them.
benefits: Dawnbreaker Cohorts and the Angel's Tears may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They also gain Sun Behind Them: Deep Strike, and they may still Charge on the turn they arrive.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Initiative.
limitations: At least two Assault Squads or Veteran Assault Squads are required.
Dawnbreaker Cohorts and the Angel's Tears must start the battle in Reserve.
No Heavy sub-type Infantry, no Armour and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: The Descent of the Host: Line (1), Sun Behind Them.
The Descent of the Host: +1 I.

require.note: Bring at least two Assault Squads or Veteran Assault Squads.

rites.name: Thirst of the Red Wings
rites.flavor: Sanguinius could hold the rage in his sons. Without him it was a tide.
benefits: Every non-vehicle model gains +1 Attack on a turn it charges.
Every non-vehicle unit gains The Red Thirst: +1 to Charge rolls, and a free 3" move toward the enemy after destroying a unit in combat.
limitations: Units with The Red Thirst must charge if an enemy unit is within 12" at the start of their Assault phase.
No Apothecaries, no Recon units and no Support units other than Techmarines.

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: +1 A.
modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: -1 CL, The Red Thirst.

rites.name: The Celestial Court
rites.flavor: A Legion of ten thousand, and only the finest ever walk in the Primarch's shadow.
benefits: Sanguinary Guard, Crimson Paladins and Ofanim Courts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2).
They also gain Unbroken Court: re-roll failed Morale Checks, passing automatically within 6" of a friendly Warlord or High Command model.
limitations: At least one Sanguinary Guard and one Crimson Paladin pack are required.
No Tactical Squads, Despoiler Squads or Inductii.

modifiers.text: The Celestial Court: Line (2), Unbroken Court.

require.note: Bring at least one Sanguinary Guard.
Bring at least one Crimson Paladin pack.

rites.name: Pyre-Brothers of Baal
rites.flavor: The old ones burn, and they remember. They are very, very angry.
benefits: Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Entombed Rage: if charged they fight at normal Initiative with +1 Attack, and they gain Fear (1).
limitations: At least two Contemptor-Incaendius are required.
No Recon units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: Pyre-Brothers of Baal: Line (1), Entombed Rage.

require.note: Bring at least two Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts.
